title: -ette words, 'it' before the verb
summary: Words ending in -ette are feminine: la baguette, la cigarette, la bicyclette. 'It' (le / la / l') goes right before the verb it belongs to: je veux le réparer = I want to repair it, je dois la réparer = I must repair it (the car).
points: -ette words are feminine: la baguette, la cigarette, la bicyclette.
Use le for masculine things, and also for 'it' in general (getting something done).
'It' goes just before the verb that acts on it: Je veux le réparer (I want it to-repair).
le / la become l' before a vowel: Tu dois l'organiser.
If you hear a final consonant, the word probably ends in -e: la porte, la visite, trente.
